description: This file defines a test store for integration testing, including functions to create enterprise and professional license configurations with specific feature sets, and a method to retrieve the license.

classes.name: TestStore
classes.description: A test store structure embedding store.Store and holding a license for testing purposes.

methods.name: NewTestEnterpriseStore
methods.description: Creates a new TestStore with an enterprise license configuration with all features enabled.

methods.name: NewTestProfessionalStore
methods.description: Creates a new TestStore with a professional license configuration with a subset of features enabled.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Returns the license associated with the TestStore.
